name: Default
shortDescription: Automated browser that claims free games on Epic Games Store, Amazon Prime Gaming and GOG once a day, with a noVNC web view for logging in.

alerts.message: On the first run, open the app URL, connect with the VNC_PASSWORD value from the environment and log in to each store in the remote browser within LOGIN_TIMEOUT seconds. Restart the app to retry a missed login. Alternatively set EMAIL, PASSWORD and the OTP keys for automatic login.
Epic Games may show a captcha when claiming from the container; solve it in the remote browser when it appears.
